item.title: Fans Choose Stray Kids ‘This & That’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update! We've got the latest on what's trending, and it's all about Stray Kids. Their new eight-song collection, "THIS & THAT", is taking the top spot in our new music poll.
[Short music clip from "THIS & THAT"]
Host: With an impressive 85% of the vote, Stray Kids dominated the competition, beating out new releases from Karol G, Madonna, and Kylie Minogue, among others. The collection features a mix of tracks, including the anthemic title song "THIS & THAT", which already has a music video with over 62 million views on YouTube.
[Short clip from the music video]
Host: The album kicks off with "RUN IT" and includes other tracks like "After You", "FARMING", and "Way Out". This is Stray Kids' latest release via JYP Entertainment and the REPUBLIC Collective.
[Short music clip from another track]
Host: While it's too early to see where "THIS & THAT" will land on the official charts, Stray Kids have a history of debuting at number one on the Billboard 200. We'll be keeping an eye on that.
[Outro music starts]
Host: That's all for now. Check out the full poll results and Stray Kids' new music on our website. Thanks for tuning in!
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
